project_identity.name: KuvaNest
project_identity.tagline: Your Files. Your Photos. Your Storage. One Simple Nest.
project_identity.positioning: India-first personal cloud storage & smart backup platform. Simple alternative to Google Drive/Photos with local INR pricing, archive import (Google Takeout, iCloud, Dropbox, OneDrive, Azure), family vaults, high speed regional servers, and admin governance.
project_identity.emotional_archetype: ORGANIC & WARM HIGH-TRUST TECH (Warm Golden Yellow, Soft Stone Greys, High Contrast Clear Typography, Tactile Folder Cards)

rules.anti_inter_heading: DO NOT use Inter for section titles or main headings. Use Plus Jakarta Sans or Outfit for character and friendly authority.
rules.h1: text-3xl sm:text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-extrabold tracking-tight text-[#202124]
rules.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-bold tracking-tight text-[#202124]

spacing_and_radii.touch_targets: min-h-[44px] min-w-[44px] for effortless tapping on mobile

header_and_navigation.mobile_bottom_nav: Fixed bottom bar on mobile with 5 items: Home | Photos | Files | Transfer | Account. Active state highlighted with warm yellow tint (#FFF7E6) and #E5AA16 icon/text.
header_and_navigation.desktop_header: Sticky top bar with opaque blurred background (backdrop-blur-md bg-white/90 border-b border-gray-100 z-50). NEVER transparent.
header_and_navigation.dropdown_rule: Dropdown menus MUST have opaque background (bg-white text-[#202124] shadow-xl border border-gray-100 z-50). NEVER transparent.

testing_and_accessibility.data_testid_requirement: CRITICAL: Every interactive button, link, form field, file row, folder card, tab, modal close, and dropdown menu MUST include an explicit data-testid attribute in kebab-case (e.g. data-testid="home-folder-my-photos", data-testid="storage-upgrade-button", data-testid="files-upload-btn").
testing_and_accessibility.contrast_standard: All body text must achieve a minimum 4.5:1 APCA/WCAG contrast against backgrounds. Dark grey text (#202124) on white/yellow light backgrounds.
testing_and_accessibility.keyboard_nav: Full keyboard access with clear yellow focus ring (focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#E5AA16] focus:outline-none).

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Read this guidelines file carefully before modifying frontend code.
2. Use JavaScript (.js / .jsx) components as per the project setup.
3. Maintain warm golden yellow (#E5AA16) as the main brand identity. Ensure folder icons and primary CTA buttons feature rich yellow hues.
4. Ensure mobile-first responsiveness with a clean bottom navigation bar on screens under 768px (Home | Photos | Files | Transfer | Account).
5. Use Lucide icons (Folder, Image, FileText, Upload, RefreshCw, Users, Shield, HardDrive, Trash2, Settings, CreditCard, ChevronRight, Search, Grid, List, etc.).
6. Make sure all modals (upload, migration, file preview, checkout) have clear backdrop overlays (bg-black/50) and robust data-testid tags.

7. Include all 10 views/pages smoothly switchable or routable (Landing, Login, Dashboard Home, Files Browser, Photos Gallery, Transfer Migration, Recycle Bin, Billing & Plans, Account, Admin Dashboard).
8. Never leave dropdowns or header backgrounds transparent. Always use explicit bg-white or solid frosted glass.
